name: Lexicodex
summary:
Lexicodex is an online trading card game (TCG) developed by the creators of Tusmo. Free-to-play directly in your web browser, the game offers a unique, culture-focused experience where every card represents a Wikipedia article or a dictionary word (famous figures, places, works of art, concepts, and more).

Players can open daily booster packs, collect the rarest cards, build the value of their collection through an auction market and player-to-player trading, and compete against each other in duels.
